scope: one resource-install diagnostic Python child only; no loader/compiler/producer exec

resourcePolicy.desiredHard: budget when inherited hard equals exact RLIM_INFINITY; otherwise min(inherited hard,budget)
resourcePolicy.missingASOrInstallError: retain named limit, before/desired/readback if possible, exact exception and failure terminal; no fallback

diagnosticRecordPolicy: ordinary child body logs before and flushed success/failure after each limit setter; do not use preexec_fn; bounded three limits in fixed order; stop on first failure
retention: overcap raw retained/hashed without decoding; completion only after exact ordered receipt validation and child reap
limitations: read-only current limits do not reproduce the failed child environment
preexec failure does not identify the failing setter
successful get/set/readback does not prove kernel physical-memory enforcement
Python child bootstrap runs before child-body installation; parent outer wall/raw supervision still applies
Interpreter executable pinned; full Python shared-library/stdlib/platform closure is not established. Product compiler/loader is never invoked.
capturePolicy: pipes drained under outerwall; retain at most first65536 bytes per stdout/stderr; overflow stops and refuses without decoding. Separate durable journal is bounded65536 bytes before each append and fsynced before stdout emission.
